description: Reservoir Volumes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by SA Water. Contains the volume and location of water stored in the reservoirs supplying metropolitan Adelaide. Information is captured daily. The dataset contains the data collected on the last business day of the month, and includes average monthly volumes for each of the reservoirs. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher SA Water. Its tags are Reservoir Capacity, Water, metropolitan adelaide, reservoir, water volume. It offers 94 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
